title: Final mutation boundaries require authentic non-replayable decisions
statement: Every governed filesystem, Git-ref, database, or remote side effect MUST be represented by an exact plan or exact independently authorized bounded batch and MUST be re-verified immediately before mutation by its final adapter using a single-use capability issued by the active process-local authority issuer; structural clones, correctly rehashed reconstructions, foreign-issuer values, expired values, changed targets, and replays MUST refuse without side effects.
rationale: Public decision fields and hashes prove consistency, not origin. Final-boundary issuer membership is required to make the authority decision load-bearing against direct imports and replay.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
